verdict.rationale: macOS ships its own automation surfaces: the help guide documents automating tasks with Shortcuts, and community users drive the OS from scripts with built-in command-line tools (pbcopy/pbpaste, qlmanage, hidutil, networkQuality). The evidence never describes a documented public programmatic API for driving the system, and the probes found no OpenAPI spec or llms.txt. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of a public programmatic API (e.g., scripting/automation interfaces with reference docs), evidence that the CLI tools are formally documented, and coverage of what can be controlled programmatically.
